backend/main.mo: Defines an empty Motoko actor as a placeholder backend with no methods or state.
feature_evidence.json: Machine-generated report mapping implemented product features to frontend files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Reference document summarizing the purpose of each frontend file and component in the Mookie’s single-page website.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining design tokens, color themes (light/dark), radius, and base styles for the site.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with SEO metadata, social sharing tags, JSON-LD structured data for the café, and font preloads.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that assembles all major page sections in order for the single-page site.
frontend/src/components/mookies/animatio: Custom React hook using IntersectionObserver to trigger reveal animations when elements scroll into view.
frontend/src/components/mookies/assets.t: Centralized constants for image asset paths and menu item metadata used throughout the site.
frontend/src/components/mookies/business: Single source of truth for all exact business details such as name, address, phone, hours, and ratings.
frontend/src/components/mookies/OrderOnl: Modal dialog component that explains online ordering is coming soon and provides a call-to-order phone CTA.
frontend/src/components/mookies/sections: About section presenting Mookie’s story, community focus, and dog-friendly vibe with icon highlights.
Footer displaying brand info, contact details, hours, Instagram link, and site attribution.
Full-screen hero section with background image, logo, headline, rating, and CTA buttons to scroll to the menu or open an order dialog.
Displays a grid of highlighted menu items with reveal-on-scroll animations and a button to scroll to the full menu section.
Shows customer reviews and star ratings using static review data and overall business rating info.
Provides address, hours, phone, directions link, and an embedded Google Map for the business location.
Lists key reasons customers like the café using icon-text cards in a responsive grid.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity and React Query, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, identity persistence, and login status state.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining café-themed color tokens, light/dark mode variables, base styles, accessibility focus styles, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling class-based dark mode, scanning frontend source files, and extending the theme with container settings, extensive OKLCH-based color tokens, custom radii, shadows, fonts, and animations. It integrates typography, container queries, and animation plugins to support a modern, responsive design system.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing the goals, scope, and current state of building a mobile-first marketing website for the coffee shop “Mookie’s at Mugford.” It lists implemented feature requirements covering page structure, content sections, CTAs, branding, and UX behavior with versioned tracking.
